name: Edison Scientific
tagline: Kosmos, the AI scientist — autonomous literature and data-analysis research runs.
insight: Spun out of the Eric Schmidt-funded nonprofit FutureHouse in Nov 2025, raising a $70M seed at a ~$250M valuation weeks later.
description: The for-profit spinout commercializing nonprofit lab FutureHouse's scientific agents. Its flagship Kosmos runs autonomous research campaigns — iterating data analysis, literature search, and hypothesis generation — and returns fully cited research reports. The Edison Platform took over FutureHouse's hosted literature agents, with the first Kosmos runs free for academic researchers.
edge: Kosmos runs multi-hour autonomous campaigns over ~1,500 papers per run — deeper than single-shot literature agents.
pros: Every finding linked to code or citations
First six Kosmos runs free for academics
cons: $200 per Kosmos run after the free quota
Focused on biology and chemistry domains
Runs take hours — built for depth, not speed

references.title: FutureHouse spinout Edison lands $70M to build autonomous AI scientists
